title: Slovakian Braised Beef Shin Hash
description: A hearty, comforting Slovakian-inspired dish featuring tender beef shin in a rich, spiced hash.
instructions: Season beef shin with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear beef shin until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove beef from pot and set aside.
Add onion and garlic to pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add hash, caraway seeds, and spiced vinegar to pot. Cook for 2 minutes.
Return beef to pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer pot to preheated oven and braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
